description: Worked evidence for Bennett's Point. Keep the selected fields of two operator-published observations, the operator's separate installation history, and our attribution distinct. This is project evidence, not a live feed or CSAPI wire payload.

operator_record.credit: ACE Basin National Estuarine Research Reserve, South Carolina Department of Natural Resources, research coordinator Dr. Denise Sanger; NOAA National Estuarine Research Reserve System (NERRS) System-wide Monitoring Program, Centralized Data Management Office (CDMO).
operator_record.title: ACE Basin (ACE) NERR Meteorological Metadata, January–December 2024

locators.site: Station table, printed p. 3, and section 10, printed p. 11: Bennett's Point / acebpmet.
locators.method: Section 4, printed p. 2: EST year-round; air temperature in degrees Celsius as a 15-minute average of 5-second samples.
locators.probe_history: Section 9: Temperature and Relative Humidity; Temp/RH sensors 3 and 4, printed p. 6.
locators.logger_history: Section 9: CR1000X loggers 1 and 2, printed pp. 10–11.
locators.flags: Sections 11–12, printed pp. 11–12: parameter-specific flags and additional codes.
locators.work_window: Section 13, printed p. 13: maintenance April 16 and operating-system update April 17.

probe_model.description: Air temperature and relative humidity probe

installation_note.scope: This was a station maintenance window covering multiple sensors. The note confirms a temperature/humidity sensor installation; the serials come from the equipment history, not from this note. It does not timestamp the individual probe change.

logger_context.source_scope: The active unit recorded the station summaries. It is not either EE181 probe; this is not a ClimaVue installation or a manufacturer PanelTemp example.

measurement_file.citation: NOAA NERRS, System-wide Monitoring Program; ACE Basin, Bennett's Point meteorology, 2024; accessed 2026-10-31. Dataset DOI: 10.25921/vw8a-8031.
measurement_file.selection: Find the two DatetimeStamp strings below and their StationCode; header is line 1. Each station/date selector returned exactly one row in the inspected copy. CDMO may revise the archive. Only the temperature evidence is excerpted here, not the annual dataset.

field_key.ATemp: Air temperature, degrees Celsius; 15-minute mean of 5-second samples.
field_key.F_ATemp: Parameter-level quality flag: <0> means passed initial QAQC checks, not a calibration certificate or proof of instrument identity.
field_key.F_Record: Record-wide flag, retained separately. Flags on other parameters do not qualify ATemp.

measurement_file.time_basis: DatetimeStamp is the station's published stamp in EST (UTC−05:00) year-round. The UTC values below are our conversions; the CSV does not supply an independent publication/result time.

attribution_method: For each ATemp field, match the station (trim CSV padding), the air-temperature equipment role, and the full 15-minute measurement period to the reserve's dated equipment history. Each selected interval is strictly inside one probe's documented period of use. Neither CSV row contains a probe serial number. Do not apply this inference to other parameters in the row.

excluded_example.reason: Not selected: temperature rejected during a logger operating-system update (§13). The presence of a numeric value does not override the flag.

limits: Same-day equipment-history endpoints have day precision. Neither midnight nor an exact changeover instant is asserted.
The December 2024 as-of date is not a removal date; document revision and observation timestamps serve different purposes.

These two historical station records demonstrate attribution across a swap, not calibration agreement, causation of a temperature difference, a complete station configuration, live interoperability or full Profile conformance.
